title: fix(lint): the inline-edit advisories read every inline-edit mode, not only inlineEdit: true
body:
Fixes #34636
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os lint` 的两条主从明细建议(`relationship/line-items-inline-edit`、`relationship/association-inline-edit`)现在把 `inlineEdit` 的三种取值 `true` / `'grid'` / `'form'` 都当作“已行内编辑”。
- 为什么改:之前两条规则只认 `true`。作者已选 `'grid'` 或 `'form'` 的明细行仍被建议改成 `inlineEdit: true`,会覆盖作者自己选的模式;评论、审计、动态这类关联对象写 `'grid'` / `'form'` 时又收不到警告。
- 风险与回滚:只影响 lint 建议,不拒收任何元数据,运行时零变化;规则 id、级别、提示文案都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` 里新增的 `isInlineEdited` 与 R5、R6 两处条件;再看 `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.inline-edit-advisories.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/data-model-rules.inline-edit-advisories.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`FieldSchema.inlineEdit` accepts `true`, `'grid'` and `'form'`, and every reader treats all three as inline-edited (the console's inline subforms read any truthy value; the spec's `isBodyTableRelationship` and the sibling `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk` rule spell out all three). Two advisories in `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` read only the literal `true`:

- **R5 `relationship/line-items-inline-edit`** fired on `inlineEdit !== true`. A `*_line` child whose `master_detail` declares `'grid'` or `'form'` was told to "consider inlineEdit: true", with a fix that replaces the author's chosen mode. It is now silent for all three values and fires only when `inlineEdit` is absent or `false`, which is the case its message and fix are written for.
- **R6 `relationship/association-inline-edit`** fired on `inlineEdit === true`. An association child (comments, audit, activity) declaring `'grid'` or `'form'` clutters the parent's entry form the same way and drew no warning. It now warns for all three.

All three sites (R5, R6, and the existing `inline-edit-needs-bulk` loop, which restated the three values inline) now call one file-local predicate, `isInlineEdited(def)`. It is not exported. The spec has no standalone "is inline-edited" export: `isBodyTableRelationship` answers a different question (it also reads `relatedList`, and only for `master_detail`), so reusing it would change R6's reach.

Rule ids, severities, messages and fix text are unchanged. The published reference `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md` already describes the corrected behaviour ("without `inlineEdit`" / "marked `inlineEdit`"), so no doc edit is needed. The `inline-edit-needs-bulk` site is a behaviour-identical refactor.

## Tests

New file `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.inline-edit-advisories.test.ts`, 10 cases:
- R5 is silent for `true`, `'grid'`, `'form'`; it suggests (severity `suggestion`, path `objects[1].fields.order.inlineEdit`) for absent and `false`.
- R6 warns (severity `warning`, same path, exactly one finding) for `true`, `'grid'`, `'form'`; it is silent for absent and `false`.

The new test file was run against the unmodified source. Exactly the four `'grid'` / `'form'` cases were red, and the `true`, absent and `false` controls were green:

```

× is silent when the line-item relationship declares inlineEdit: form
× warns when an association relationship declares inlineEdit: grid
× warns when an association relationship declares inlineEdit: form
Tests  4 failed | 6 passed (10)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one per rule (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation landed and restored, verified on disk)</summary>

The test imports `./data-model-rules.js` from source, not through a package's `exports`, so no dist rebuild leg applies.

- R5 condition reverted to `def.inlineEdit !== true`: anchor x1 to x0, blob 78bd12081be5 to 72e0563d1751. Red: `is silent … inlineEdit: grid`, `… form` (2 failed, 8 passed). Restored: blob equals HEAD 78bd12081be5, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- R6 condition reverted to `def.inlineEdit === true`: anchor x1 to x0, blob 78bd12081be5 to 85ab31f4f1fc. Red: `warns … inlineEdit: grid`, `… form` (2 failed, 8 passed). Restored: blob equals HEAD 78bd12081be5, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`. The new test file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly` count 1).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/data-model-rules.test.ts` (it pins both rules through lint's dist): 64 passed. This run was on the pre-merge head.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The changeset is `@objectstack/lint` patch. Nothing an author can write changes (`Metadata-protocol: none`). An advisory now fires on two more accepted values, so `Clause-②: no`.
